argv: $pidOld=(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object {$_.CommandLine -match 'python(.exe)?"? -m agentos_node.client_cli run'} | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty ProcessId); if(-not $pidOld){throw 'thin_client_pid_missing'}; $cmd="Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; Stop-Process -Id $pidOld -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Start-Sleep -Seconds 3; Start-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'AgentOS Thin Client'"; Start-Process powershell.exe -WindowStyle Hidden -ArgumentList @('-NoProfile','-NonInteractive','-Command',$cmd); Write-Output ('reload_pid='+$pidOld)
